messages.author: 03d6e87fd598d518
messages.subject: clade label angles on left side of circular tree are upside down
parts:
Dear Guangchuang,

First, thank you very much for you tree viewing and editing package. It has been wonderful over the last couple of years.

My question is whether or not it is possible to use angle="auto" with cladelabel() function to return the correct orientation?

I seemed to have seen a post saying that it is possible with the github version, but after installing github version, I am still having no luck. 

Attached as a tree with the labels in the incorrect orientation.

If there is an easy fix, I would be very grateful to hear your response. Otherwise I have to take these trees into illustrator which I usually try to avoid.

Thanks,

Bob

messages.subject: Re: clade label angles on left side of circular tree are upside down
parts:
Sure thing. Here is an example from the tutorial.
Note the test label at about 10 o'clock on the circular tree is upside down.

Thanks so much for your help! 

set.seed(2015-12-21)
tree <- rtree(30)
p <- ggtree(tree, layout="circular") + xlim(NA, 6)

p + geom_cladelabel(node=45, label="test label", angle="auto") +
    geom_cladelabel(node=34, label="another clade", angle="auto")
